title: Evaluation of a Rapid and Practical Deep Learning Framework for T1-weighted MRI-based Brain Age Estimation.

summary: 回顾性研究用免费Python工具构建脑龄估计框架，在多个外部队列验证脑龄差与痴呆诊断等指标的关联。

abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Purpose To develop and evaluate a rapid brain-age estimation framework using freely available Python tools and assess the clinical relevance of brain-age gap (BAG). Materials and Methods In this retrospective study conducted from March 2025 to August 2026, T1-weighted MR images from cohorts of cognitively normal adults (n = 4,346) were divided into training, validation, and internal test sets; two cohorts (n = 315 and 209) served as external test sets. Clinical evaluation used the BICWALZS cohort (n = 954; cognitively normal and various dementias). Preprocessing used freely available Python tools only. The model was trained to predict chronological age as the reference standard. Associations of the residualized BAG with diagnosis, amyloid PET positivity, white matter hyperintensity (WMH) severity, stroke history, and longitudinal clinical worsening were evaluated using ANCOVA, logistic regression, and Cox models. Results The development cohort included 4,346 cognitively normal adults (mean age, 47.0 ± 21.2 years; 2,414 women). Chronological age prediction yielded R2 = 0.95 and MAE, 3.76 years in the internal test set and R2 = 0.69-0.90 and MAE, 4.82-5.15 years in external test sets. The residualized BAG increased across diagnostic groups (P < .001) and was associated with WMH severity (odds ratio [OR], 1.64; P < .001) and stroke history (OR, 1.46; P < .001), but not with amyloid positivity after full adjustment (P = .17), and predicted longitudinal clinical worsening (HR, 1.92). Conclusion The framework accurately predicted age, while residualized BAG was associated with diagnosis, cerebrovascular burden, and longitudinal clinical worsening. © RSNA, 2026.
zh_abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence]【目的】开发并评估一个使用可免费获取的 Python 工具的快速脑龄估计框架，并评估脑龄差（brain-age gap，BAG）的临床相关性。【材料与方法】在这项于2025年3月至2026年8月开展的回顾性研究中，将来自认知正常成人队列（n = 4,346）的 T1 加权 MR 图像分为训练集、验证集和内部测试集；两个队列（n = 315 和 209）作为外部测试集。临床评估使用 BICWALZS 队列（n = 954；认知正常及各类痴呆）。预处理仅使用可免费获取的 Python 工具。模型训练以预测实际年龄作为参考标准。使用 ANCOVA、logistic 回归和 Cox 模型评估残差化 BAG 与诊断、淀粉样蛋白 PET 阳性、白质高信号（WMH）严重程度、卒中史及纵向临床恶化之间的关联。【结果】开发队列包括4,346名认知正常成人（平均年龄47.0 ± 21.2岁；女性2,414名）。实际年龄预测在内部测试集中得到 R2 = 0.95、MAE 为3.76岁，在外部测试集中得到 R2 = 0.69-0.90、MAE 为4.82-5.15岁。残差化 BAG 在各诊断组间升高（P < .001），并与 WMH 严重程度（比值比 [OR]，1.64；P < .001）和卒中史（OR，1.46；P < .001）相关，但在完全校正后与淀粉样蛋白阳性无关（P = .17），并可预测纵向临床恶化（HR，1.92）。【结论】该框架能准确预测年龄，而残差化 BAG 与诊断、脑血管负荷及纵向临床恶化相关。© RSNA，2026。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Xiangya Hospital of Central South University; conditions: Prostate Cancer, mCRPC (Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1115; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] The goal of this multicenter observational study is to develop and validate an artificial intelligence-based digital pathology model to predict treatment response and prognosis in adult men with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer treated with androgen deprivation therapy plus androgen receptor signaling inhibitors. The main questions it aims to answer are: Can digital pathology-based artificial intelligence predict deep prostate-specific antigen response, defined as prostate-specific antigen less than 0.2 ng/mL at 6 to 7 months after treatment? Can digital pathology-based artificial intelligence predict progression to metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and time to metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer? Researchers will compare artificial intelligence-defined low-risk and high-risk groups to evaluate whether the model can improve prediction of treatment response and prognosis beyond conventional clinicopathological risk stratification. Participants will not receive any additional intervention as part of this study. Researchers will retrospectively collect clinical characteristics, treatment records, prostate-specific antigen response data, follow-up outcomes, and archived prostate biopsy slides from participating centers. The biopsy slides will be scanned into whole-slide images and analyzed using artificial intelligence to develop and validate predictive models.

title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
zh_title: 生物医学研究智能体的决策溯源审计
summary: 预印本提出BioAgent-DF方法，测试科研智能体在证据读取与引用改变时结论是否保持不变。
key_points: 在相同计算位置复原或移植参考值与候选值
八个SciFact批次中Qwen3.5-4B与Gemma 3 4B IT出现可重复变化

reason: 智能体评测新方法预印本，有对比实验但证据范围有限，未经同行评审
abstract: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes in four. These seven combinations cover two claims. Full restoration recovers the reference evidence sets while verdicts remain unchanged. Verdict changes observed under the baseline prompt did not recur under the explicit-example prompt. Complementary tool and optimizer experiments distinguish recovery of numerical state, recovery of ranked lists, and restoration of an agent's visible history. These results show that an audit should track both the evidence an agent uses and its final answer. In hERG cardiac-safety assay allocation, silent numerical faults changed testing decisions while the fixed-budget shortlist kept the same number of compounds labeled as blockers. After the agent had used faulty values, restoring its earlier execution state and supplying certified scores recovered all 39 changed decisions, whereas replacing the prediction file recovered none; no incorrect action was committed. A streaming implementation of the arithmetic checks reduced the total time for forward execution and verification by 42.4% relative to the original FP64 implementation, with identical flags and recovery outputs.
zh_abstract: 科学智能体在阅读并引用不同证据时可能给出相同结论。BioAgent-DF 使用保存在同一科学计算位点的配对参考值和候选值来检验这种分离。它将这些值恢复或移植到其原始坐标，然后在健康硬件上运行该智能体。在八个 SciFact 批次中，Qwen3.5-4B 在三种 capture-claim 组合中表现出可重复的引用变化，Gemma 3 4B IT 在四种组合中表现出可重复的读取和引用变化。这七种组合涵盖两项主张。完全恢复可恢复参考证据集，同时结论保持不变。在基线提示下观察到的结论变化在明确示例提示下未再出现。互补的工具和优化器实验区分了数值状态的恢复、排序列表的恢复以及智能体可见历史的恢复。这些结果表明，审计应同时追踪智能体使用的证据及其最终答案。在 hERG 心脏安全性测定分配中，静默数值故障改变了检测决策，而固定预算短名单中标记为阻断剂的化合物数量保持不变。在智能体使用故障值之后，恢复其较早的执行状态并提供经认证的评分，恢复了全部39个发生改变的决策；而替换预测文件则未恢复任何决策；未实施任何不正确操作。算术检查的流式实现相对于原始 FP64 实现将前向执行和验证的总时间减少了42.4%，且标记和恢复输出完全相同。

title: EvoSurv: Evolution-Aware Multimodal Survival Modeling Reveals Complementary Prognostic Signals
zh_title: EvoSurv：整合演化信息的多模态生存模型
summary: 提出整合基因组演化特征的多模态生存模型，在六个TCGA癌种中C-index优于三种方法。
key_points: 构建38维基因组演化特征eTime
整合临床变量与RNA表达
六种TCGA癌种2782例，平均C-index 0.663
reason: 多癌种公共队列回顾性预印本，有基线对比但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate cancer survival prediction remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity. Although multimodal survival models integrate clinical and molecular data, they often overlook evolutionary information encoded in genomic alterations. To address this gap, we developed eTime, a 38-dimensional evolutionary representation comprising eight feature groups that characterize clonal and subclonal mutation burden, mutational spectra, functional consequences, copy-number alterations, and anoikis-related genomic changes. We further developed EvoSurv, a multimodal survival framework integrating eTime with clinical variables and RNA expression. Across six TCGA cancer cohorts comprising 2,782 patients, EvoSurv achieved the highest mean concordance index (C-index) in all six cancers, averaging 0.663 and outperforming three state-of-the-art survival prediction methods. More importantly, we assessed whether evolutionary features provide additional prognostic information beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors. eTime remained significantly associated with survival in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSC) and liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) after adjustment for clinical variables and RNA-derived risk scores. Feature-group analyses further revealed cancer-specific prognostic patterns. In HNSC, T>G substitutions were associated with increased mortality risk after clinical and molecular adjustment, including in HPV-negative patients, with supporting evidence from an independent CPTAC-HNSCC cohort. Overall, these findings demonstrate that eTime captures survival-associated evolutionary information and highlight its potential to provide prognostic value beyond clinical and transcriptomic predictors.
zh_abstract: 由于肿瘤异质性，准确的癌症生存预测仍然具有挑战性。尽管多模态生存模型整合了临床和分子数据，但它们常常忽视基因组改变所编码的进化信息。为解决这一空白，我们开发了 eTime，一种 38 维进化表征，包含八个特征组，用于刻画克隆和亚克隆突变负荷、突变谱、功能后果、拷贝数改变以及失巢凋亡（anoikis）相关基因组变化。我们进一步开发了 EvoSurv，一个将 eTime 与临床变量和 RNA 表达整合的多模态生存框架。在包含 2,782 名患者的六个 TCGA 癌症队列中，EvoSurv 在所有六种癌症中均取得最高平均一致性指数（C-index），平均为 0.663，并优于三种最先进的生存预测方法。更重要的是，我们评估了进化特征是否提供临床和转录组预测因子之外的额外预后信息。在调整临床变量和 RNA 衍生风险评分后，eTime 在头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSC）和肝细胞癌（LIHC）中仍与生存显著相关。特征组分析进一步揭示了癌症特异性预后模式。在 HNSC 中，T>G 替换在临床和分子调整后与死亡风险增加相关，包括在 HPV 阴性患者中，并有来自独立 CPTAC-HNSCC 队列的支持证据。总体而言，这些发现表明 eTime 捕获了与生存相关的进化信息，并突显其提供超越临床和转录组预测因子的预后价值的潜力。

abstract: [Cardiovascular & hematological disorders drug targets] One of the main causes of death in the world is Cardiovascular Diseases (CVDs). The number of acute myocardial infarctions and fatalities may be considerably decreased by early detection of Cardiovascular (CV) events. However, the efficacy of conventional data analysis for diagnosis and treatment is hampered by the complexity of the disease and the wide range of affecting factors. Large, multidimensional medical datasets can be processed by Artificial Intelligence (AI) owing to its sophisticated computational capabilities. This narrative review was conducted through a structured search of PubMed/ MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar to identify peer-reviewed literature on artificial intelligence in cardiovascular medicine. Relevant studies addressing diagnosis, risk stratification, prognostic prediction, cardiovascular imaging, and clinical implementation were critically evaluated with emphasis on methodological quality, external validation, clinical applicability, and implementation challenges. AI-based systems have been shown to be more effective at classifying risk, predicting outcomes, and spotting illness trends. Early diagnosis and more customized treatment plans are made possible by these algorithms' ability to examine intricate relationships in large healthcare datasets. Clinical applications have improved auxiliary diagnostic instruments and increased patient care effectiveness. AI offers more accuracy and flexibility than traditional approaches when handling high-dimensional CVD data. It may reduce the burden of disease and promote tailored treatment regimens. However, data quality, standardization, and ethical concerns for broad use remain issues. The detection and treatment of CVDs are being revolutionized by AI-powered technology. Their use in clinical settings may improve cardiovascular care and lower the number of heart disease-related deaths worldwide.
zh_abstract: [Cardiovascular & hematological disorders drug targets] 心血管疾病（CVDs）是全球主要死亡原因之一。早期发现心血管（CV）事件可能显著减少急性心肌梗死和死亡的数量。然而，疾病的复杂性和影响因素的广泛性阻碍了传统数据分析在诊断和治疗中的效力。人工智能（AI）凭借其先进的计算能力，可以处理大型多维医学数据集。本叙述性综述通过对 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 进行结构化检索，以识别关于人工智能在心血管医学中应用的同行评审文献。对涉及诊断、风险分层、预后预测、心血管影像和临床实施的相关研究进行了批判性评价，重点关注方法学质量、外部验证、临床适用性和实施挑战。基于 AI 的系统已被证明在风险分类、结局预测和识别疾病趋势方面更有效。这些算法能够检查大型医疗保健数据集中的复杂关系，从而使早期诊断和更个性化的治疗方案成为可能。临床应用改进了辅助诊断工具并提高了患者护理效果。在处理高维 CVD 数据时，AI 比传统方法提供更高的准确性和灵活性。它可能减轻疾病负担并促进定制化治疗方案。然而，数据质量、标准化以及广泛使用的伦理问题仍然是问题。AI 驱动的技术正在彻底改变 CVDs 的检测和治疗。它们在临床环境中的使用可能改善心血管护理并降低全球心脏病相关死亡人数。

title: Automated MRI-Based Segmentation of the Cranio-Cervical Venous System Using a Dedicated Deep Learning Pipeline

nnU-Net v2五折平均DSC 0.94

abstract: PURPOSE To develop an automated magnetic resonance imaging based segmentation pipeline for the cranio-cervical venous system (CCVS), a complex anatomical network for which no dedicated segmentation tool is currently available. MATERIALS AND METHODS A retrospective single-center cohort of 194 contrast-enhanced cranio-cervical MRI examinations acquired between 2019 and 2024 was used. Manual reference segmentations were performed on 50 examinations using 3D Slicer. A nnU-Net v2-based segmentation model was trained through an iterative process combining automatic segmentation, manual correction, and retraining. Segmentation performance was assessed using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC). The complete processing pipeline was integrated into an open-source software application, VenousNetworkAnalyzer (VNA). RESULTS The final model achieved a mean DSC of 0.94 (95% CI, 0.93-0.95) in five-fold cross-validation on 106 examinations with manual reference segmentations. Iterative optimization progressively reduced manual processing time from approximately 10 hours of fully manual segmentation to less than 10 minutes of manual correction per patient. Application of the final model to the entire cohort enabled the generation of patient-specific three-dimensional reconstructions of the cranio-cervical venous system. The segmentation workflow was successfully integrated into the VNA software environment, allowing automated processing and visualization of MRI datasets. CONCLUSION This study demonstrates the feasibility of automated segmentation of the cranio-cervical venous system from contrast-enhanced MRI using a dedicated deep-learning pipeline. The resulting reduction in processing time and integration into an open-source software platform provide a foundation for future large-scale anatomical studies of cranio-cervical venous draina
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发一种基于磁共振成像的颅颈静脉系统（CCVS）自动分割流程；CCVS 是一个复杂解剖网络，目前尚无专用分割工具。【材料与方法】使用 2019 年至 2024 年间采集的 194 次对比增强颅颈 MRI 检查构成的回顾性单中心队列。使用 3D Slicer 对 50 次检查进行人工参考分割。通过结合自动分割、人工校正和再训练的迭代过程，训练了一个基于 nnU-Net v2 的分割模型。使用 Dice 相似系数（DSC）评估分割性能。完整处理流程已整合到开源软件应用 VenousNetworkAnalyzer（VNA）中。【结果】在 106 次具有人工参考分割的检查上进行五折交叉验证，最终模型达到平均 DSC 0.94（95% CI，0.93-0.95）。迭代优化逐步将人工处理时间从完全人工分割约 10 小时缩短至每名患者人工校正少于 10 分钟。将最终模型应用于整个队列，能够生成患者特异性的颅颈静脉系统三维重建。分割工作流程已成功整合到 VNA 软件环境中，可对 MRI 数据集进行自动处理和可视化。【结论】本研究证明使用专用深度学习流程从对比增强 MRI 自动分割颅颈静脉系统是可行的。由此带来的处理时间缩短以及整合到开源软件平台，为未来颅颈静脉引流的大规模解剖研究提供了基础。
